Hi Jordan,

Galena's SOC2 auditor has asked us to provide samples and evidence for authentication and provisioning controls covering our integration with Redwood. Specifically the auditor requested:  

- SAML assertion example(s) showing NameID and attribute mappings (redact PII but keep attribute names)

- redwood_saml_assertion_samples.jsonl  (2 records: nameid/email and persistent id; attributes: email, groups, role_id — PII replaced with user_0001 etc.)

Retention and storage statement (for auditor):
- Assertion logs: SAML assertions are logged in encrypted object storage (S3) for 90 days by default; extraction for audit purposes can be performed with a retention exception and delivered via a presigned S3 link under an NDA.
- SCIM deltas: SCIM change feed is persisted for 120 days in the change-log bucket; delta exports include sequence numbers and ISO8601 timestamps.
- Role snapshots: Tenanted role/permission manifests are retained for 365 days in the config-archive (csv exports available on request).

Redaction note: All provided samples have user identifiers replaced with pseudonyms (user_0001, user_0002). Any exported raw logs will have a redaction plan and access approval from Redwood Security.

Next steps:
- If the auditor asks for raw logs, please loop in your legal/compliance and we'll coordinate a controlled transfer.
- If you want a short walkthrough for the auditor, I can join a 30-min call next week and demo the export process.

Thanks,
